notes.title: Update 1.0.1.6 – Critical Fixes & UI Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]⚡ [b]Update 1.0.1.6 – Critical Fixes, UI Polish & Better Gameplay Flow![/b][/h1][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Changelog – Version 1.0.1.6[/h3][p]🔧 Critical Fixes & Improvements[/p][list][*][p]🛠 Fixed a critical bug that prevented the game from loading at certain points.[/p][/*][*][p]💾 Enhanced save error handling to prevent unexpected behavior and improve reliability.[/p][/*][*][p]🗓️ Fixed issue with incorrect save date display.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ Improved how save files are loaded and stored.[/p][/*][/list][p]🧭 UI & Visual Tweaks[/p][list][*][p]🎨 Polished several UI screens for a cleaner and more consistent experience.[/p][/*][*][p]🐠 Fixed submarine tooltip overlapping panel.[/p][/*][*][p]🔤 Adjusted text sizes for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]📢 Fixed trading notification bugs – popups now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 Resolved issue where trading mission popups would appear off-screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]⚔️ Gameplay Flow[/p][list][*][p]🤝 Fixed bug where liberating a country could wrongly result in -25 diplomacy points.[/p][/*][*][p]💡 Added more tooltips to key mechanics for improved clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]🚨 Colony attack warnings are now clearer and more noticeable.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]👀 [b]Sneak Peek – Mobile Version Coming Soon![/b]
We’ve officially started [b]internal testing and optimizations[/b] for the [b]mobile version[/b] of [i]Countryballs: Power Protocol[/i]!
You’ve been asking for it, and now it’s happening. Expect the same strategic chaos on your phones and tablets soon! 📱🔥[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for all your feedback and reports – this game is growing because of you! 🙌
Stay tuned and keep conquering![/p]

tags.bug: 🛠 Fixed a critical bug that prevented the game from loading at certain points.
💾 Enhanced save error handling to prevent unexpected behavior and improve reliability.
🗓️ Fixed issue with incorrect save date display.
🛠️ Improved how save files are loaded and stored.
🐠 Fixed submarine tooltip overlapping panel.
📢 Fixed trading notification bugs – popups now display correctly.
🌍 Resolved issue where trading mission popups would appear off-screen.
🤝 Fixed bug where liberating a country could wrongly result in -25 diplomacy points.

tags.feature: 💡 Added more tooltips to key mechanics for improved clarity.
🚨 Colony attack warnings are now clearer and more noticeable.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.6 – Critical Fixes & UI Improvements

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.5 – Big Fixes, Smoother Gameplay & Mobile Sneak Peek!
notes.content: [h3][b]Changelog – 1.0.1.5[/b][/h3][list][*][p]📊 Improved stat tracking so your progress, scores, and records are always accurate and up to date.[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 Fixed achievement unlocking issues – every achievement you earn should now appear correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ Interface improvements – menus, buttons, and UI elements now work smoothly and look sharper.[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ Balanced army parameter calculations for fairer, more consistent management.[/p][/*][*][p]🧭 Made explorer missions more stable to prevent unexpected interruptions.[/p][/*][*][p]💼 Fixed steal and business missions so they give the proper rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 Optimized performance for faster loading, smoother gameplay, and lower resource use.[/p][/*][*][p]🌐 Corrected translation mistakes across several languages for clearer communication.[/p][/*][*][p]📜 Mission screen fixes – information now displays clearly and completely.[/p][/*][*][p]☢️ Resolved multiple issues with the nuke bomb mechanic so it behaves as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]🗺️ Updated country dashboard for better clarity and more useful info.[/p][/*][*][p]💾 Rebuilt parts of the save system for more reliable saving/loading.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Squashed a wide range of smaller bugs for improved stability and overall enjoyment.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]📱 Sneak Peek – Mobile Version Coming Soon![/b][/h3][p]We’ve heard you loud and clear! The demand for a [b]mobile version[/b] has been huge, and we’re working hard to bring Countryballs: Power Protocol to your phones and tablets very soon. Stay tuned for more details – it’s going to be epic![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Thank you for your continued support and feedback – you’re helping us make this the best Countryballs game ever![/b][/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.0.1 – Quality of Life & Balance Improvements!

Here's what's new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ [b]Revamped Endgame Screens[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Victory Screen[/b] reworked for a more satisfying campaign finish[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lose Screen[/b] updated with clearer feedback and UI[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔄 [b]Trade System Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated [b]Trading Policy[/b] descriptions for better clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced [b]Trade mechanics[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Capped maximum trade deals to [b]30 units[/b] to prevent extreme values[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛡️ [b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Minor [b]Army balance changes[/b] for smoother play[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 [b]Bug Reports & Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Redesigned [b]Bug Report Ticket screen[/b] for easier issue submission[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several exceptions that caused crashes or odd behavior[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We're continuing to improve the game based on your feedback. Please keep the bug reports coming, and thank you for playing![/p][p]❤️
[b]– The Dev Team[/b][/p]
